{{Translation notice}} [[File:Pokémon 4Koma Plaza logo.png|thumb|200px|Logo on Pokémon Daisuki Club]] '''Pokémon 4-Koma Comic Strip''' (Japanese: '''ポケモン４コマ{{ruby|広|ひろ}}{{ruby|場|ば}}''' ''Pokémon 4Koma Plaza'') is a [[Pokémon 4Koma]] {{pkmn|manga}} by [[Takahiro Yamashita]]. It is [http://www.pokemon.jp/look/comic/ published] once weekly each Monday on [[Pokémon Daisuki Club]] in {{pmin|Japan}}. Starting in September 2020, English versions of each comic began to be posted on the official Pokémon social media accounts in {{pmin|India}} ([https://www.facebook.com/official.pokemon.india Facebook], [https://www.instagram.com/_pokemonofficialindia/ Instagram]), {{pmin|Malaysia}} ([https://www.facebook.com/PokemonMalaysia Facebook]), {{pmin|the Philippines}} ([https://www.facebook.com/OfficialPokemonPH Facebook]), and {{pmin|Singapore}} ([https://www.facebook.com/Pokemon.official.Singapore Facebook], [https://www.instagram.com/pokemonofficial.sg/ Instagram]).
